name: All Saints chancel

layers.essential_history: [[c:Only the 13th-century chancel of All Saints survives: the rest of the church was pulled down in 1825. Inside are Montagu monuments, including Henry Montagu, who died in 1625.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Barnwell once had two parish churches, St Andrew's and All Saints, side by side in one village.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:Under a pew is the saddlebag, but it's empty. Someone got here first. Time to head back and make your accusation.]]

directions_to_next: [[c:Take the footpath north from All Saints across the fields back into the village, then turn right past the almshouses to the Montagu Arms. About 700 metres.]]
